validate.description: Run the full validation suite (fmt, clippy, test, deny, machete).
validate.template:
Run the full validation suite for this repository. Use CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0 CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_SPLIT_DEBUGINFO=none for builds (7.8GB RAM, no swap). Run in order:
1. cargo fmt --check
2. cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
3. CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_DEBUG=0 CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_SPLIT_DEBUGINFO=none cargo test --workspace
4. cargo deny check
5. cargo machete --with-metadata
6. python3 -c "import tomllib,pathlib;[tomllib.loads(p.read_text()) for p in pathlib.Path('.').rglob('*.toml') if '.git' not in p.parts and 'target' not in p.parts]"
7. cargo metadata --no-deps --format-version 1 > /dev/null
Report pass/fail for each step.

safety-gate.description: Run the TETANUS safety-critical validation gate (deny, machete, bloat).
safety-gate.template:
Run the safety-critical validation gate for changes to themql-gnc, themql-estimation, themql-inference, or themql-artifact:
1. cargo deny check
2. cargo machete --with-metadata
3. cargo bloat --release --crates -p themql-desktop
Report pass/fail for each. These enforce the NASA JPL Power of Ten rules codified in TETANUS.md.
